Maldives is not a destination, it's a feeling! 🤯🇲🇻😍🏝️

📍 Four Seasons Resort Maldives at Kuda Hura

This Beach Villa feels like a whole mansion! Soo much space and the longest private pool I've ever seen in a resort 🤯😍 with direct walking access to the white sandy beach.

No golf buggy. No long walk. No "beach view" that requires binoculars. Just open the door and you're there. 🏝️

The one thing you'll love the most about the Maldives, are endless villa options. One day you're waking up in an overwater villa with crystal-clear water, the next day you're stepping straight from your villa onto what feels like your own private beach.

reels.caption:
Possibly one of my most favourite places in the whole of Lake Como, is the beautiful Villa del Balbianello 💙

The villa was originally a private residence, but is now a museum owned and run by the Italian National Trust, FAI. It's one of the "must see/do" highlights in Lake Como and I can assure you it won't disappoint.

The views across Bellagio and the Alps from the most iconic spot (the three arched loggia) is simply breathtaking. During high season you'll often see people saying their "I do" here, can you imagine having this as your backdrop to your wedding photos?

Have you visited this beautiful villa in Lake Como? TAG someone who would love to and SAVE this for when you plan to visit ❤️🇮🇹
